title: Software development with AI is starting to feel like cooking steak
content: Article URL: https://blog.sydorets.com/en/posts/almost-no-skill-required-to-cook-a-steak/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49198069 Points: 365 # Comments: 385
summary: 文章将AI辅助软件开发比作烹饪牛排，认为现代AI工具大幅降低了编程门槛，使开发者更像厨师而非工匠，但核心技能（如问题分解、架构设计）依然重要。作者通过个人经验讨论AI在代码生成、调试和重构中的实际效果，并指出过度依赖AI可能削弱基础能力，强调平衡使用。
highlights: AI让编程从'写代码'转向'指导代码'，如同烹饪牛排时控制火候而非亲手切肉。
真正稀缺的是定义问题和验证结果的能力，而非机械编码。
作者发现AI在重构和测试生成上节省大量时间，但复杂逻辑仍需人工介入。
过度依赖AI会导致对错误模式的钝感，建议定期脱离工具练习基础。

title: Humans missed 1 in 3 threats approving AI agent commands across 40k game runs
content: Article URL: https://scalex.dev/blog/ai-agent-permissions-stats/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49195468 Points: 298 # Comments: 211
summary: 一项涉及40,000次游戏运行的研究发现，人类在批准AI代理命令时遗漏了三分之一的威胁，凸显了AI代理权限管理中的安全漏洞。
highlights: 人类在40k次游戏运行中批准AI代理命令时，遗漏了1/3的威胁。
研究揭示了AI代理权限审批流程中的重大安全风险。
该发现强调了改进人机协作安全机制的必要性。

title: Why Do Cognitive Scientists Hate LLMs? (2023)
summary: This article explores the reasons why cognitive scientists are critical of large language models (LLMs), highlighting fundamental differences in how these models process information compared to human cognition, and discussing the implications for understanding intelligence.
highlights: Cognitive scientists argue that LLMs lack the embodied and grounded understanding that characterizes human cognition.
The article examines the disconnect between statistical pattern matching in LLMs and the causal, compositional reasoning in human minds.
It discusses how LLMs' performance on language tasks does not necessarily reflect genuine understanding or intelligence.
